what_this_decides: which design earns a short training run, nothing else
population_is_reused_development_data: PAPER_EVAL positive has already been used for development. A good number here may never be called held-out, independent, or final.

evaluation_contract.negatives_not_used: this is a pose screen; the 2689 negatives are not needed
evaluation_contract.cross_model_detection_scores_not_compare: YOLO and DOPE score semantics differ, so no AUROC, FPR95 or AP ranking between them

arms.S0: current YOLO26n-Pose through the frozen prediction-only selector

S1.name: point-only translation refit control
S1.purpose: separate any S2 gain from the mere act of re-optimising a pose
S1.objective: robust reprojection of the cuboid corners against S0 predicted keypoints

S2.name: point plus YOLO bbox translation refinement

residuals.point: 16 coordinate residuals, x and y of 8 corners
residuals.bbox: 4 residuals, left right top bottom of the projected cuboid bbox against the YOLO bbox
residuals.normalisation: each residual divided by the original image width or height
residuals.group_balance: each block divided by sqrt of its residual count, so the point block does not become four times stronger by size alone

S2.reading_rule: a fall in the objective is not a pass. If predicted reprojection improves while GT IoU or ADDsym falls, it is the same failure as the rejected DiffPnP seed.

S3.name: full-canvas bbox-gated DOPE decoding
S3.context: square centred on the YOLO bbox, side 1.25 x max(width, height), clipped to the image
S3.rule: candidate peaks outside that square are not preferred for that keypoint
S3.no_heatmap_modification: no beta, no sigmoid, no learned prior; this arm has no tunable weight
S3.fallback: if no candidate lies inside the context, mark BBOX_GATE_FALLBACK and report it separately rather than silently counting a raw DOPE candidate as a success

S4.name: square-context ROI DOPE
S4.differs_from_the_rejected_crop: the rejected version used a tight bbox resized to a 400 short side, which turned edge-on pallets into wide strips. This crops a square, so the object aspect ratio is unchanged.
S4.crop: square centred on the bbox, side 1.25 x max(width, height), padded outside the image, resized to 400x400
S4.padding_justification: the instruction offered constant 127 as a fallback if an authoritative audit showed reflect to be worst. It does not: MECHANISM_DIAGNOSTIC_REPORT compares both without condemning reflect, and the recorded convention is that DOPE inference requires reflect padding because plain squash systematically under-detects truncated and close-range pallets. The authoritative convention is followed and the deviation from the fallback is recorded here.
S4.inverse_map_gate: a unit test must map synthetic points original to crop to resize and back with max coordinate error below 1e-4 px, or S4 does not run

S5.name: line rotation plus point/bbox translation
S5.why: every line artifact in this repository (paper_s2_multihead line_uncertainty, line_signed_bias, point_line_solver) was produced on the synthetic multihead populations D0_MH_SEEN512 and D2_MH_DEV512. No line prediction cache exists on the real 319 frames, and no canonical adapter maps that model onto this population. The lock's own rule says an unclear compatibility ends the arm rather than inventing one.

optimizer_rules_S1_S2.existing_helper_searched: the repository has solvePnPRefineLM in several places but no translation-only least-squares convention, so the values below are declared here
optimizer_rules_S1_S2.nan_or_inf: fall back to the original t0

historical_rejections_not_retried.predicted_seed_full_6dof_diffpnp: _docs/audits/PREDSEED_DIFFPNP_GATE.md — REJECT. Predicted 2D reprojection 11.96 to 6.35 px, but fixed GT reprojection 23.16 to 24.20 px and rotation +13.8 percent worse. Fitting harder to biased keypoints is not pose accuracy.
historical_rejections_not_retried.diffpnp3d_retraining: paper_s2_scratch_diffpnp/CONCLUSION.md — PARTIAL transfer. Rear and sub-3-degree gains, no overall pose accuracy gain.
historical_rejections_not_retried.tight_strip_dope_crop: the rejected crop turned edge-on pallets into extreme wide strips and collapsed rear localisation; S4 uses a square instead
historical_rejections_not_retried.fixed_lambda_corner_line_multitask: _docs/audits/MULTIHEAD_FAILURE_DIAG.md — the gradients agree weakly (cosine +0.13 to +0.25); the magnitude ratio moved about 35,000x during training, so a lambda fixed at step 0 is meaningless by step 25,000

dimension_conditioning.reason: exact dimensions already enter the PnP geometry; whether network-level conditioning adds anything to keypoint localisation needs evidence first

promotion_gate.primary: delta IoU3D >= +0.020 OR delta ADDsym AUC >= +0.020
and_simultaneously: the other primary metric's point estimate at or above baseline
pose coverage drop no more than 0.01 absolute
rotation median and translation median not worse than baseline by more than 5 percent
promotion_gate.dope_arms_add: pooled keypoint median not worse than raw DOPE

selection.zero_GO: FAST_6D_SCREEN = NO_PROMOTABLE_SIGNAL, no further architecture training
selection.several_GO: highest ADDsym AUC first, IoU3D breaks a tie

uncertainty.grouping: the existing session grouping of the 319 population; no new grouping is invented

existing_code_changes: only additive optional entry points or wrappers; default behaviour stays byte-compatible

dope_reference.covers_the_319: 319 of 319 frames present, 297 with detected corners
